# A book where ordinary income is written in a transaction described as a
# closing entry.
#
# The two statements read that transaction differently, which is what makes the
# book inconsistent. GnuCash's Income Statement takes a "Closing Entries
# pattern" — `Closing Entries` by default, matched against the description — and
# leaves what it matches out, because a closing entry moves the year's profit
# into equity rather than earning anything. The balance sheet has no such rule:
# whatever an income account holds is in `retained_earnings`.
#
# So the 500.00 CAD below is inside the sheet's retained earnings and outside
# the income statement's net income, and the two figures disagree by it on a
# book that balances perfectly well. Neither page is wrong on its own terms;
# the description is.
#
# `--verify-integrity` is what reads one against the other and says so.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_verify_integrity_checks_whether_a_book_is_consistent_and_balanced.py.
2032-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2032-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2032-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2032-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2032-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2032-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2032-01-01 open Income:Consulting
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2032-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 1000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -1000.00 CAD

2032-03-31 * "Consulting billed and collected"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 2000.00 CAD
	Income:Consulting -2000.00 CAD

# Ordinary income, described as a closing entry. The income statement leaves it
# out and the balance sheet keeps it in.
2032-06-30 * "Closing Entries"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 500.00 CAD
	Income:Consulting -500.00 CAD
